영어: Scene 1
1A Big Crowd
Jesus went to a quiet place. Many people came to see Him.
한글: 예수님께서는 조용한 곳으로 가셨어요. 많은 사람들이 예수님을 보러 왔어요.

영어: Mommies and daddies came. Boys and girls came too.
한글: 엄마 아빠들이 왔어요. 남자아이들과 여자아이들도 왔어요.

영어: They sat down on the grass.
Jesus smiled at them. He talked to them about God.
한글: 예수님께서는 그들을 보며 웃으셨어요. 예수님께서는 하나님에 대해 말씀해 주셨어요.

영어: The day got late.
Scene 2
2. No Food
The people stayed all day.
Now they felt hungry. Their tummies made noise.
한글: 이제 그들은 배가 고팠어요. 배에서 꼬르륵 소리가 났어요.

영어: The helpers looked around. “There is no food here,” they said.
한글: 제자들이 주위를 둘러보았어요. “여기에는 음식이 없어요.” 그들이 말했어요.

영어: “Send the people to the town.” “They can buy food there.”
한글: “사람들을 마을로 보내요.” “거기서 음식을 살 수 있어요.”

영어: But Jesus had a different plan.
Scene 3
3. A Boy’s Lunch
One little boy was there. He brought his own lunch.
한글: 한 소년이 그곳에 있었어요. 그는 자기 도시락을 가져왔어요.

영어: He had five pieces of bread. He had two small fish too.
한글: 그는 떡 다섯 개를 가지고 있었어요. 그는 작은 물고기 두 마리도 가지고 있었어요.

영어: A helper named Andrew saw the boy.
The boy was not afraid.
He gave his lunch to Jesus.
It was a very kind thing to do.
Scene 4
4. Jesus Said Thank You
Jesus took the bread and fish.
He held them in His hands. He looked up to heaven.
한글: 예수님께서는 그것을 손에 드셨어요. 예수님께서는 하늘을 올려다보셨어요.

영어: “Thank You, God,” Jesus said. “Thank You for this food.”
한글: “하나님, 감사합니다.” 예수님께서 말씀하셨어요. “이 음식을 주셔서 감사해요.”

영어: Then Jesus broke the bread. He broke the fish too.
한글: 그리고 예수님께서는 떡을 나누셨어요. 물고기도 나누셨어요.

영어: He gave the pieces to His helpers.
한글: 예수님께서는 그 조각들을 제자들에게 나눠 주셨어요.

영어: Scene 5
5. More and More Food
The helpers gave out the food.
One person got some bread. Then another person got some too.
한글: 한 사람이 떡을 받았어요. 그다음 사람도 받았어요.

영어: The basket did not become empty!
More bread kept coming out. More fish kept coming out too.
한글: 떡이 계속 나왔어요. 물고기도 계속 나왔어요.

영어: The helpers were very surprised.
God was making more food appear.
Scene 6
6. Everyone Was Full
So many people ate the food. There were five thousand people!
한글: 아주 많은 사람들이 음식을 먹었어요. 오천 명이나 되는 사람들이 있었어요!

영어: Every single person got some food.
No one was left hungry. Everyone ate until they were full.
한글: 아무도 배고프지 않았어요. 모두 배부를 때까지 먹었어요.

영어: The children smiled and laughed. The people said, “Wow!”
They knew Jesus did something amazing.
한글: 그들은 예수님께서 놀라운 일을 하셨다는 걸 알았어요.

영어: Scene 7
7. Twelve Baskets Left
Everyone was full and happy. But there was still food left!
한글: 모두 배부르고 행복했어요. 그런데도 음식이 남아 있었어요!

영어: Jesus said, “Pick up the extra food.”
The helpers walked around and gathered it.
They filled one basket. Then they filled another basket.
한글: 그들은 바구니 하나를 채웠어요. 그다음 바구니도 채웠어요.

영어: In the end, they filled twelve baskets!
Jesus can do big things with a little.
한글: 예수님께서는 작은 것으로도 큰일을 하실 수 있어요.
